summary: Threaded /new_goal message_id through plan delivery and preface ack via optional replyToMessageId on runGoalInBackground/sendPlanResult/sendGoalPlanResult/sendDagPng/sendGoalPlanMessage (plus sendGoalReply support), and added tests covering sendPhoto success, sendDagPng text fallback, sendGoalPlanMessage fallback, minimal fallback, and runGoalInBackground preface reply threading.
